project_name.justification: The article is titled "Teako Minerals Acquires the Advanced and Fully Permitted District Scale Yellow Moose Gold Project in BC, Canada" and refers to the acquisition of the "Yellow Moose project (the \"Property\" or \"Yellow Moose\")".

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified as "TEAKO MINERALS CORP. (CSE: TMIN) (the "Company" or "Teako")".

ceo_buyer.justification: The press release is signed off "ON BEHALF OF TEAKO MINERALS CORP. 'Sven Gollan' CEO".

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The text states that Teako is "acquiring a 100% interest in the Yellow Moose project".

primary_commodity.justification: The title of the article is "Teako Minerals Acquires the Advanced and Fully Permitted District Scale Yellow Moose Gold Project in BC, Canada".

verified_article_link.justification: The article is about the Yellow Moose project acquisition by Teako Minerals Corp. The source link is provided at the bottom of the text: "To view the source version of this press release, please visit https://www.newsfilecorp.com/release/174184".

currency.justification: The currency is inferred from the mention of a Canadian dollar amount for the NSR buyback: "Teako can buy back 1% of the NSR, thus reducing the NSR to 1%, for a price of CAD $1,000,000."

cash_payments_raw.justification: The consideration for the acquisition is in shares, not cash. The terms state "The issuance of 3,500,000 shares of the Company to Cuprita".
